notes.title: 100 Times thank you!
notes.content:
[h3]So I don't really know how to write this but, fundamentally, thank you.  [/h3][p]

[b]SHIATH[/b] has been out for a couple of days now, and it sold over 100 copies, which I know may not sound like much, but to me, is really everything, definitely surpassing my expectations. 

With this message, I just want to thank everyone who played SHIATH, shared it with their friends, streamed it even!   

A special thanks goes to all my friends who "volunteered" to playtest it (love you guys, really), to [url="https://store.steampowered.com/search/?developer=Studio%20Carota"]Studio Carota[/url] for helping me out during the development (You know what a wild rise has been), to all those who left such positives and heart warming reviews of the game and to all those that, in someway or the other, had their part in this journey, you know who you are and I thank you from the bottom of my heart.  


This has been quite a rough year, but seeing now that people enjoy my game and what I have to say makes all the effort worth it, and it is my intention to follow up with more and more games, since it is quite clear to me now that this is my call.   

I also decided that, to venture forward in this adventure, we need a proper boat, so I officially opened a Discord server for those of you crazy enough to follow me closely during the making of my other projects.   [/p][h3]
You can join by clicking [url="https://discord.gg/vkPPS5YD4d"]right here[/url]!  [/h3][p]
Well, that's it for now, again, thank you for everything, can't wait to share more with all of you!  [/p][h3]
-theJameskrik [/h3]
